answer: Let standing decay on a short half-life unless refreshed by recent graded work, so influence is always today's earning and never a hull moored forever at the wharf. A meadow left uncut goes to seed; an identity that falls quiet darkens toward sable and gutters to zero. A farmer cannot stockpile dormant clones and wake them for one coordinated vote, because each account must do real work every epoch to hold its place, so an idle swarm shrinks while the active agent alone keeps its height.
